snippet.title: Sunken Stones release date trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
A turn based Puzzle-Strategy game about pirates and cursed treasure. Choose a captain, gather your crew and defeat monsters by strategically placing units on a 5x5 grid.

Sunken Stones, from Spritewrench, releases on July 18, 2025.

Sunken Stones in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/sunken-stones/

Sunken Stones on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601810/Sunken_Stones/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkgames.com/direct/
